title: Zoning
noZones: No zones yet. Create a zone and assign elements to it.
name: Zone name
deleteBody: Zone “{name}” will be removed from the draft. Its elements will become unassigned. Changes reach the server only when saved.

help.inspect: Select an element to view its details.
help.brush: Choose a zone and select an element to assign it.
help.area: Drag a rectangle. Fully enclosed elements are assigned to the active zone. On a touch screen use one finger; switch tools to scroll.
help.eraser: Select an element to remove its zone assignment.

unassignedHint: A dashed border indicates an unassigned element. Unassigned elements are allowed.
selectElement: Select a floor plan element to view details.

validation.clientId: Zone ID must be unique, 1–64 letters, digits or _ . : -.
validation.name: Trimmed name must contain 1–80 characters.
validation.duplicateName: Zone names must be unique regardless of case.
validation.emptyZone: Assign at least one element to this zone.
validation.assignment: Assignments must reference existing elements and zones.

discarded: Assignments referencing a missing element or zone: {count}. They will be excluded when saving.
saved: Zoning saved. Current zones and assignments have been loaded.
changed: A conflict was detected. The current request has been loaded. Review zoning before submitting again.
unsavedBody: Leaving will discard changes to zones and assignments. Leave without saving?

errors.invalid_plan: The floor plan is missing or invalid. Return to the previous step.
errors.invalid_zones: The server rejected the zones. Check the highlighted panel.
errors.invalid_assignments: The server rejected assignments. Check the highlighted links on the plan.
errors.revision_conflict: The request changed. Reload it first.
errors.invalid_status: The request status changed. Editing is disabled.
errors.forbidden: You do not have access to this operation.
errors.not_authenticated: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.unresolved: The save result could not be confirmed. Further writes are blocked until the request is checked.
errors.unknown: The operation failed. Try checking the request state.
errors.invalid_response: Zoning could not be read: the server response does not match the contract.
errors.plan_too_large: The floor plan exceeds the size limit.
errors.duplicate_element: Duplicate element IDs in the plan.

hints.plan: Save a valid floor plan first.
hints.zones: Provide 1–200 zones, each with at least one element.
hints.zones_name: Use a unique name of 1–80 characters.
hints.assignments_element_id: An element must exist in the plan and have at most one zone.
hints.assignments_zone_client_id: Each assignment must reference an existing zone client_id.
